about: Speed limits read off the sign by a driver, for roads where OpenStreetMap records none. tools/build-routing.mjs gives each one to the pieces of the named road that lie wholly inside its box and carry no limit of their own. box is south, west, north, east. A limit OpenStreetMap does carry always stands, and the build says when a line here has nothing left to do.
